attributes.provenance: src/game/sys/memcard.c::check_prefs_loaded (worktree GDL-Claude-Memcard, commit 47c0428bc): `char* st = lbl_801131C0;` declared/initialized at fn entry (alongside another pointer local `opts`), but consumed only once, 9 statements later, right before the function's tail. Target computes BOTH pointers' HA halves early into scratch registers and defers BOTH LO resolutions to direct-to-final-callee-saved-register addi's issued right after the frame's stmw -- zero extra moves for either. Our reconstruction fully resolved st's address (HA+LO) into a scratch register before stmw (since it was a plain single-statement initializer with nothing deferring it), forcing an extra `mr r30,r0` after stmw to relocate it into its permanent home. Decl-order reshuffling (swapping opts/st declaration order) was tried FIRST and made zero difference -- confirms this is not a decl-order artifact. Fix: bare-declare the pointer, move its assignment to immediately before its sole use. Result: insns 58->57 (exact target match), real diff 37->26, lines 41->30.
attributes.scope: MWCC GC 1.2.5 family, opt_lifetimes-off-style reconstructions; applies to a local pointer/constant computed from an SDA21/ADDR16-relocated global, declared and initialized at function entry, but read only ONCE, later in the function body, with no intervening dependency on the value

subject: compiler:mwcc-gc-1.2.5
value: When a single-use local pointer/constant (derived from an SDA21/ADDR16 global) is declared with an initializer at function entry, but its sole read happens later in the function body, an eager `T* p = GLOBAL;` initializer forces MWCC to fully resolve the address (HA+LO) into a scratch register before the frame's stmw makes the eventual home register safe to write, adding an extra `mr`/move once stmw completes. The tell: target's disassembly shows this value's address computed via a SPLIT HA-early/LO-directly-into-final-register pattern (matching a genuinely early-needed multi-use value), or, if target computes it fresh right at the point of use instead (no persistent callee-saved home at all), the extra move disappears entirely. Fix: change the local to a bare declaration and move its assignment statement to immediately before its single use, deep in the function body. This is a control-flow-position change, not a declaration-text-order change -- plain decl-order reshuffling (moving the declaration line while keeping the initializer at entry) does NOT reproduce this effect and was independently disproven this session (5 negative decl-order probes across loadGauntletSave x2, init_all_dir_info, check_prefs_loaded's own decl-order sub-probe, plus the DoOptions/show_optmenu precedent). Companion to claim.law.whole-fn-address-cache.20260829.v1 (which handles the opposite case: a MULTI-use address that needs hoisting/caching to a persistent register); this law is for SINGLE-use values that should instead be pushed OUT of the persistent-register pool entirely. Caveat: the fix can trade an eliminated prologue `mr` for a new `lis+addi+mr` cluster at the call site if the value is passed as a call argument, so net instruction count only improves when the eliminated persistent-register upkeep (the `mr` plus any register-pressure cascade) outweighs the added point-of-use computation; verify with fndiff --count before committing, and expect a possible objdiff fuzzy-score/real-diff-line metric conflict (see AGENTS.md's get_cam_wpos_8002ABE0/show_optmenu precedent) since the code motion shifts local alignment even when the raw instruction stream is strictly closer.
